summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only verification of the new per-flower Masterclasses feature on Patch & Pot. All acceptance criteria pass against the live preview URL. Verified: /masterclasses index now renders two sections — section-foundations (3 cards: propagation, pest-control, plant-care, default 3-col grid) and section-flowers (12 cards in compact grid 'grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5'); all 12 flower data-testids present (rose, dahlia, peony, tulip, lily, sweet-pea, cosmos, zinnia, sunflower, aster, chrysanthemum, lavender) each showing image, duration ('About N minutes'), title, tagline and 0% progress bar (style 'width: 0%'). Detail-page deep dives confirmed: /masterclasses/rose renders masterclass-detail-rose with 5 lesson-nav slugs (varieties, planting, growing, pruning, problems), Lesson 1 'Choosing the right rose' prose contains 'Olivia Rose Austin' and the box 'Rose types in 90 seconds'; /masterclasses/dahlia has 5 nav slugs (varieties, planting, growing, problems, storage), Lesson 1 mentions 'Bishop of Llandaff' and 'Karma Choc' and the 'Shapes worth knowing' box; /masterclasses/sweet-pea has 5 nav slugs (varieties, sowing, supports, picking, problems), Lesson 2 'Sowing and root run' shows steps section 'Sweet pea sowing routine'. Full completion run on Lavender (slugs varieties→planting→watering→pruning→uses): clicking mark-complete-btn on each of the 5 lessons (waiting 600ms each for the 250ms auto-advance) results in localStorage 'patchpot.masterclass.v1' containing {"lavender":{"varieties":true,"planting":true,"watering":true,"pruning":true,"uses":true}}, masterclass-complete card appearing on lesson 5 with exactly 3 next-masterclass links, and index page progress bar updating to width:100% (and persisting after reload). Lesson nav + Next/Previous tested on rose (Lesson 1 has no prev, has next; clicking next routes to /rose/planting; mark-complete auto-advances to /rose/growing). Regression: foundation propagation /masterclasses/propagation/seed → mark-complete still auto-advances to softwood-cuttings; nav-masterclasses present with EN label 'Masterclasses' (i18n for DE/FR/JA/ZH fully verified in iteration 3 and unchanged); Home feature--masterclasses card present; /calendar download-month-btn present; /plants/tomato, /garden, /guides/cut-flowers (PDF download links visible) all render. No console errors.

issues: Lavender Unsplash image (photo-1471197497129-bdac0b54bd5e) returns 404 — the card falls back to the broken-image icon with alt text 'Lavender'. The card still functions and lesson content renders fine. The review request explicitly notes this kind of 404 is acceptable, but if main agent wants pixel-perfect output a replacement Unsplash URL would help.

Several flower image URLs are reused across cards (e.g. sunflower-photo also used for dahlia/aster/sunflower; tulip-photo also used for sweet-pea & zinnia; cosmos-photo also used for chrysanthemum), so the cosmos/chrysanthemum cards show an unrelated dark blue underwater photo and sweet-pea/zinnia show tulips. Request explicitly says reuse is acceptable for now — flagging for future polish.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace the Lavender Unsplash URL — current one 404s — with a working lavender photo.

(Optional polish) Diversify the reused Unsplash image map in /app/frontend/src/data/flower-masterclasses.js so cosmos/chrysanthemum/sweet-pea/zinnia/aster cards each have a visually-appropriate image.
critical_code_review_comments: flower-masterclasses.js IMG map has duplicated URLs across distinct flowers (sunflower used for dahlia/aster/sunflower; tulip for sweet-pea/zinnia; cosmos for chrysanthemum; peony for lily). Functional but visually misleading. Worth fixing post-MVP.

MasterclassDetail.jsx 'Object.keys(ALL_MASTERCLASSES).filter(s !== slug).slice(0,3)' for completion suggestions always returns the same 3 (rose, dahlia, peony — registry order after foundations) regardless of which masterclass was just completed. For Lavender we tested it returned Propagation/Pest Control/Plant Care (first 3 of the foundation registry). Consider rotating or biasing toward the same section (flowers → flowers).

FLOWER_MASTERCLASS_ORDER in flower-masterclasses.js (rose, dahlia, peony, tulip, lily, sweet-pea, cosmos, zinnia, sunflower, aster, chrysanthemum, lavender) differs from the FLOWER_MASTERCLASSES object insertion order (dahlia, aster, rose, sweet-pea, tulip, sunflower, peony, cosmos, zinnia, lavender, lily, chrysanthemum). The index page correctly uses _ORDER, but the completion-card suggestions iterate Object.keys(ALL_MASTERCLASSES) which uses insertion order — minor inconsistency.
flower-masterclasses.js is 414 lines with `/* eslint-disable max-lines */` — fine for now, but if more masterclasses are added, split per-flower to /data/masterclasses/flowers/<slug>.js.
Lesson content remains English-only across all 5 UI languages (matches spec and was noted in iter3). Document in README so future i18n work doesn't try to translate the prose.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all acceptance criteria for the 12 flower masterclasses + regression flows passed)
